name: hello-koto
description: Minimal greet-a-spirit workflow used as a smoke-test fixture

SPIRIT_NAME.description: Name of the spirit to greet

awakening.directive: Greet the spirit {{SPIRIT_NAME}} by writing a greeting to `wip/spirit-greeting.txt`. When the file exists, the workflow advances to its terminal state.

eternal.directive: The spirit {{SPIRIT_NAME}} has been greeted. The workflow is complete.
